name: an unreachable database is an opaque 503 on charset-info
description: charset-info opens a connection per node to ask which character sets it has, and a connect failure is the same ERR_DB_UNREACHABLE at 503 with the generic message. Same guarantee as schema-diff: the body names no host, port, database, query or password. The two endpoints share the failure so both fixtures pin it — a regression that started leaking would most likely do so on one code path, not both.

jsonEquals.error.message: a configured database server is unreachable
